label: bench-39-holmes-mcp-proxy-timeout
diagnosis:
### Observations
1. Pod `billing-api-665595bbf9-dk4wf` logs repeat `WARN db connection reset by peer, retrying (pool acquire 2.80s)`.
2. Deployment `billing-api` configures `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=900` (`demo-apps/billing-api`, spec.template.spec.containers[0].env).
3. Change `CI-2452` set `idleClientTimeout: 600` on `DBProxy/billing-db-proxy` (`ack-system/billing-db-proxy`, spec.idleClientTimeout).

### Ruled-out leads
1. Memory pressure logs (`heap 360 MB / 512 MB limit`) are a symptom of stalled pooled connections, not OOM (`RB-014`).
2. ALB idle timeout was raised to 120 s (`CI-2455`), so ALB keep-alive is not cutting backend database traffic.

### Root cause
`billing-api` pool idle timeout (900 s) exceeds AWS RDS Proxy `idleClientTimeout` (600 s), causing proxy drops and connection resets (`RB-014`).

### Recommended action
The billing team should lower `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` below 600 s or the infrastructure team should raise `idleClientTimeout` (`RB-014`).
